scope: credential-free local synthetic backup creation and restore admission
controls: each node runIds list exactly and uniquely matches its persisted jobs in creation order
node result pointers bind to same-project same-session result assets produced by that node
succeeded jobs require one matching result asset while non-succeeded jobs cannot claim one
result assets bind back to the exact job and node that claim them
index or result-pointer drift fails before atomic backup or restore promotion
limitations: Synthetic local fixtures do not qualify live provider settlement, staging restore or production rollback.
S-01 remains in progress pending independent review and separately authorized external reliability evidence.
